exposure: diagnosis (haemorrhage, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, sepsis)
parameters (mean blood loss, mean systolic blood pressure)
cohort: Obstetric patients in any trimester, and up to 30 days postpartum, admitted to ICU at Mater Dei Hospital in Malta between 2016 and 2021.
finding: Malta's rate of obstetric ICU admissions falls within the lower range internationally, with haemorrhage being the most common admission diagnosis.
mod_finding: Emergency Caesarean section was the commonest surgical intervention required.
